title: GPT-3.5 Turbo fine-tuning and API updates
summary: Developers can now bring their own data to customize GPT-3.5 Turbo for their use cases.
body: Developers can now bring their own data to customize GPT-3.5 Turbo for their use cases.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出GPT-3.5 Turbo的微调功能及相关API更新，允许开发者使用自有数据对模型进行定制化训练，以满足特定业务场景需求。原始信息显示：Developers can now bring their own data to customize GPT-3.5 Turbo for their use cases.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“GPT-3.5 Turbo fine-tuning and API updates”。其重要性主要体现在：GPT-3.5 Turbo微调功能的推出极大地推动了企业级大模型定制化落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
